Privacy policy

Version of 10 October 2026

What we collect

When you join the early access list: your email address, the role you choose, the page language and the time of the request. The page collects no other personal data and uses no advertising trackers.

Why

To tell you when DIMS launches and to give you the early access price. Addresses are not sold or shared with third parties for marketing.

Legal basis

Your consent, given by ticking the box in the form. You can withdraw it at any time by replying to any of our emails or writing to the contact address.

Where the data is stored

Requests arrive through a form processing service and are kept for no longer than 12 months after DIMS launches, or until you withdraw consent.

Your rights

You can ask to access, correct or delete your data. EU residents have the rights set out in the GDPR, including the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority.

Data protection contact: through the form on the main page.

DIMS © 2026

A DIMS score is an analytical indicator, not a legal finding about any source or person.
